# Draft:AK Tiwari & Associates

----
AK Tiwari and Associates
AK Tiwari and Associates is a law firm based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. The firm provides legal services in areas such as civil litigation, criminal law, matrimonial and family law, property disputes, and corporate legal advisory.
History
The firm was founded by Advocate AK Tiwari and operates primarily in the Delhi-NCR region.
The firm has been featured in online publications discussing its work in matrimonial and legal advisory services.
Practice
AK Tiwari and Associates handles a range of legal matters including family disputes, criminal defense, civil litigation, and cheque bounce cases. The firm also provides legal drafting and consultancy services.
The firm practices before various courts including district courts in Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi, as well as the Delhi High Court and the Supreme Court of India.
He has represented clients in various courts, including district courts and the Delhi High Court.
Offices
The firm is headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, and operates across multiple courts in the National Capital Region.
